We are a research group in the [Department of Economics](https://www.ekon.sun.ac.za)
at [Stellenbosch University](https://www.su.ac.za/en). Household finance is the
study of how, and how successfully, households use financial instruments to
achieve their goals.

We combine economic theory, knowledge of South Africa's institutions and
history, and survey and administrative data to address questions in this field:
how consumer financial markets work, and which policies would make them work
more efficiently and more equitably.

## Working with us

We are a new and growing group, and we are looking for data partners, research
funding, and postdocs. If you are interested in working with us, please
[get in touch](about/contact.qmd).
